name: array_prefix
source:
fn f(xs : Array[Int]) -> Int { match xs { [.. prefix, last] => prefix.length() + last
 [] => 0 } }

name: array_tail
source:
fn f(xs : Array[Int]) -> Int { match xs { [a, .. rest] => a + rest.length()
 [] => 0 } }

name: closure_nested

 y * 2 }) }
